devices.manageHelp: Manage devices and copy tabs/widget settings between them. Copying will overwrite the current device tabs and widget assignments.
devices.copyExplain: This action will COPY all tabs and widget settings from the selected device to this current client.

screensaver.heading: Screensaver
screensaver.help: The screensaver activates after a period of inactivity, cycling through tabs or displaying a photo slideshow.
screensaver.cycleTabsDisabled: Create tabs in the Tab Bar to enable this feature
screensaver.photoSlideshowHelp: Display photos from your configured sources
screensaver.photoNoSource: Configure a photo source in the Photos widget to enable this feature
screensaver.photoNoItems: Add photos to your configured source to enable this feature
screensaver.keepScreenAwakeHelp: When on, the screensaver prevents the screen from sleeping. Turn off on a wall kiosk so the device's own power management can dim and sleep the display while the screensaver runs.
screensaver.overlayHelp: Draw a little of your day over the slideshow, in the corner, in plain white text.
screensaver.overlayWeatherHelp: Uses the location and units from your weather widget.

layout.fitHelp: One photo at a time, shown whole on black.
layout.ambientHelp: One photo at a time, with a soft blurred copy of it filling the space around it.
layout.collageHelp: Several photos tiled to fill the screen, matched to spaces of their own shape. One photo changes each interval, and the arrangement changes every few rounds. Needs at least 3 photos.

vacation.heading: Vacation Mode
vacation.help: Vacation mode is for the whole household. While it is on, every display shows a vacation animation as its screensaver and can mute chore due-time chimes, and missed chores are not counted. Switching it on asks for the admin PIN.
vacation.muteSounds: Mute chore sounds while on vacation
vacation.dateHelp: With dates set, vacation starts and ends automatically, missed-chore tracking pauses for those days, and streaks bridge across them permanently. Without dates, vacation stays on until you turn it off.
vacation.pinTitle: Enter the admin PIN to turn on vacation mode
vacation.pinWrong: That PIN is not right. Vacation mode was not saved.

autoDark.locationHelp: Examples: Dallas,TX,US, London,UK, or ZIP code like 76034

users.avatarHelp: Optional — pick from the built-in set, or upload a photo after adding.

chores.dailyRewardHelp: Clams awarded when a user completes all their daily chores
chores.celebrationEnable: Celebrate when someone finishes every chore
chores.celebrationHelp: Shows confetti on every display when a user completes their last chore of the day.
chores.soundsEnable: Enable chore due-time sounds (household-wide master switch)
chores.defaultSoundHelp: Default sound (used when a chore doesn't pick its own)
chores.noChoresForUser: No chores assigned to this user.

security.help: The admin PIN is required to access the admin panel. Keep your PIN secure and memorable.

controls.heading: Controls on Displays
controls.help: Choose which parent controls each display offers. Hiding a control only stops that display from drawing it — it is not a password, and anything hidden is still available here.
controls.defaultHelp: Displays with no setting of their own follow this, including displays added later.
controls.noDisplays: No displays have checked in yet.
controls.loadFailed: Could not read the displays. Use Refresh to try again.
controls.switchHint: On means the control is shown.
controls.futureDefaultOn: Controls added later will default to on.
controls.futureDefaultOff: Controls added later will default to off.
controls.inheritingHelp: These switches follow the household default. Choose Full control or Wall display to give this display a setting of its own.
controls.unreadableHelp: We could not read this display's settings, so what it offers is unknown. Nothing has been changed for it.
controls.unlockedNotice: This display remembers the admin PIN, so it is exempt and offers every control. The settings below are saved but not in effect here. Use "{{action}}" above to apply them again.
controls.saveFailed: Could not save that change, so the displays were read again.
controls.currentUnknownHelp: We could not read the settings for the display you are using, so we cannot tell whether a change here would take controls away from it.

connections.heading: Connections
connections.openWeatherHelp: Get your free API key from openweathermap.org/api
connections.openWeatherStoredHelp: A key is saved. Leave blank to keep it, or type a new one to replace it.
connections.proxyHelp: Domains allowed for proxy requests (e.g., api.example.com, another-api.com)
connections.homeAssistantHelp: Connect Home Assistant to use it as your weather source instead of an OpenWeatherMap key. The access token stays on the server and is never sent to a display.
connections.homeAssistantUrlHelp: The address you use to reach Home Assistant, including the port.
connections.homeAssistantTokenHelp: Create one in Home Assistant under your profile, at the bottom of the Security tab.
connections.homeAssistantTokenStoredHelp: A token is saved. Leave blank to keep it, or paste a new one to replace it.
connections.homeAssistantEntityHelp: Usually weather.home. Use Test Connection to pick from a list.
